data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu made 41 GitHub contribution-count commits, with most activity in UTMIST/Misty (31) and additional work in qiuethan/now, qiuethan/Portfolio, UTMIST/UTMIST, and qiuethan/qiuethan. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#246, #254, #255, #256) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#481, #484), and opened issue UTMIST/UTMIST#483. He also reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/Misty#206 through #260 and UTMIST/UTMIST#458 through #486.
